name: Hotel San Regis Paris
positioning: Family-owned hotel in a restored 19th-century private mansion in the Golden Triangle of Paris's 8th arrondissement
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet street near the Champs-Elysees and Avenue Montaigne
Guests who prefer individually styled rooms with antiques and art over contemporary design

facts.text: The San Regis is a former hotel particulier, a private mansion, built in the 19th century.
The former mansion is today fully restored and furnished with countless works of art.
The hotel is owned by the Georges family, who wish to preserve the atmosphere of a family home.
The hotel sits on a secluded street in the Golden Triangle of Paris's 8th arrondissement.
The hotel's address is 12 Rue Jean Goujon in Paris.
The hotel is well placed for the Champs-Elysees district, Avenue Montaigne and the Grand Palais.
The hotel sits behind a discreet, understated entrance.
Each bedroom and suite has its own distinctive style.
Rooms are furnished with fabrics from leading design houses alongside antique and period furniture.
The hotel offers discreet and personalised service.
The hotel's restaurant is called Les Confidences.
Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2024 and 2025.

highlights.text: The San Regis is a former 19th-century private mansion, today fully restored and furnished with countless works of art.
The Georges family owns the hotel and wishes to preserve the atmosphere of a family home.

The furnishings and paintings have all been painstakingly hunted down.

considerations.text: The rooms are decorated with antique and period furniture, so expect a traditional look rather than a contemporary one.
WhataHotel notes limited facilities due to the hotel's boutique size.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
